title: Discord bot can send messages in a channel but gets Missing Permissions when replying
symptoms: channel.send works in the same channel
Fetching message history returns nothing even though the bot can view the channel
cause: Replying to a message needs READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY in addition to SEND_MESSAGES, and reading past messages needs it too. Role setups that grant only View Channel and Send Messages miss it.
fix: Grant Read Message History to the bot role or channel overwrite, or fall back to channel.send when the permission is missing.
apply:
if (!message.channel.permissionsFor(client.user).has(PermissionFlagsBits.ReadMessageHistory)) await message.channel.send(text);
else await message.reply(text);
affected: Discord API v10 create message with message_reference, as of 2026-10
